title: Spectral Extremal 1-Planar Graphs with Bounded Pentagon Packing
summary: Let $\mathcal P_1$ denote the class of 1-planar graphs and let $tC_5$ be the disjoint union of $t$ copies of $C_5$. For every fixed $t\ge3$ and all sufficiently large $n$, we determine the unique $n$-vertex $tC_5$-free graph in $\mathcal P_1$ with maximum adjacency spectral radius, answering Problem 1 of Li, Wang and Zhao. The proof first gives a structural description of every extremizer. After two dominating vertices are removed, the remainder consists of copies of the seven-vertex graph $B=K_1\vee2K_3$ together with at most one bounded connected core.
